title: Explainable quantum-compressed machine learning for complex fluid flows
summary: Machine-learning surrogates of physical systems face a paradox: explainable models facing the challenge of expressivity to capture complex nonlinear flows, whereas expressive deep surrogates match high-fidelity simulations only through massive parameterisations that turn the learned dynamics into a black box. Here, we introduce quantum-compressed machine learning (QCML), which resolves this tension by compressing the latent propagator of a flow surrogate from $524{,}288$ trainable parameters to no more than $8$. This parameter reduction brings the learned dynamical law to the parameter scale…
